regime: Dollar strength and rising yields keep pressure on gold as Nvidia turmoil hits tech
takeaway: Gold slipped about 0.9% to near $3,949 and silver about 1% to near $51 as the dollar index touched its highest since April 2025 and the 10-year yield returned to 5.01% when bond trading resumed after Veterans Day. Nasdaq 100 futures were down about 0.9% before the open after Nvidia fell sharply on reports about its CEO, which matters for QQQ, TQQQ and SQQQ. Gold's one-month slide (about −4.7%) keeps the gold short-term downtrend check in view, while the 2-year yield climbing to 4.78% keeps the Fed hike check active.
